messages:
Marta R.: Hey team — FYI I'm submitting my resignation. Last day will be 2026-05-15. Need to coordinate equipment return, COBRA/benefits timeline, and access removal. Can People Ops confirm next steps and who owns what? cc @Devon P.

Devon P.: Thanks for flagging, Marta. We'll own hardware pickup/return and access deprovisioning. A couple quick Qs: is it just the company MacBook + dock or are there any monitors/peripherals in the office? Any vendor or service accounts we should be aware of?

Marta R.: It's just the MacBook Pro (serial below) + USB-C dock and a company mouse. No office monitors. I do have Datadog account, occasional AWS keys (I think old), and a personal Jenkins job I maintained.

Marta R. (cont): Laptop serial: ``system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep 'Serial Number'`` — serial: C02XYZ123456

Jamal (People Ops): Marta — thanks. High-level timeline: benefits coverage ends 2026-05-15 EOD. COBRA election window will be 60 days from termination; COBRA packet will be emailed to your personal email on file within 3 business days after termination. Please confirm which personal email to use for the packet. We will also schedule an exit interview in the following week.

Marta R.: Use marta.personal@example.com for COBRA packet. Exit interview window works for me 2026-05-18 or 2026-05-19 afternoons.

People Ops Bot: Offboard ticket created: OFF-322. Assigned to: Jamal (People Ops). Equipment return policy: return within 10 business days after last day. If you need pickup, submit this form: https://company.internal/offboard-pickup.

Devon P.: For access: plan is staged removals — revoke long-lived AWS access keys on last day morning, disable Okta SSO on last day EOD, and remove org-level access (GitHub/org/gcloud) 24 hours after last day if no outstanding needs. We'll transfer ownership of any repos or CI jobs before revocation. @eng-sre can you help with Jenkins jobs and service account migration?

eng-sre: Yep, we'll audit any Jenkins jobs owned by Marta. Please list job names, or we can grep the job configs. We'll also rotate any service account keys that reference Marta's user. We'll aim to migrate by 2026-05-14 to avoid last-minute breakage.

Marta R.: Job names: "deploy-frontend-nightly" and "perf-smoke" — both have a step that calls my personal token. I can hand off permissions and update docs.

Devon P.: Great — please add new owner on those jobs (preferably @alexg) and then notify us so we can proceed with access removal. Jamal — we'll need payroll/benefits sign-off for final paycheck timing and any remaining expense reimbursements.

Jamal (People Ops): Payroll will process final paycheck on 2026-05-20 (standard final pay schedule). Please submit any outstanding expenses by 2026-05-10. We'll also run the standard offboarding checklist (devices, repo access, licenses, expense clearance) and confirm when each step is complete.

Marta R.: Submitted expenses today. I've added Alex as owner on the Jenkins jobs and updated runbooks at docs/internal/ci/offboarding.md.

People Ops Bot: Update recorded: expenses received, Jenkins owners updated. Next auto-reminder in 3 days for equipment return prep.

Devon P.: Partying aside, final actions from us: 1) confirm pickup label & box for laptop (we'll provide), 2) revoke keys and transfer CI ownership, 3) coordinate COBRA email send. Jamal, I'll send the timeline doc and access removal dates to confirm.

Jamal (People Ops): Sounds good. I'll book exit interview for 2026-05-18 at 3pm and send calendar invite. I'll also confirm COBRA email address used and mark OFF-322 as in-progress. Will post final checklist completion here once everything is done.

Marta R.: Thanks everyone — appreciate the smooth handoff. :heart:

People Ops Bot: OFF-322 status: in-progress. Will post final completion message after all items closed.
